# Release evidence

Dated source, artifact and qualification records retained independently of temporary
worknotes. These records distinguish historical measurements, accepted limits and
open evidence; they do not establish a new release or a fresh security result.

| Release | English record | Russian record |
|---|---|---|
| 0.2.0 | [Published artifact attestation](0.2.0.md) | [RU](ru/0.2.0.md) |
| 0.3.0 | [Engineering baseline and qualification](0.3.0.md) | [RU](ru/0.3.0.md) |

Standing rules belong to [RELEASE-PROCESS](../../docs/RELEASE-PROCESS.md), current
behavior to capability/consumer docs, and component publication facts to the
[component release records](../release-notes/README.md). Preserve a qualified
record's source/binary/configuration identities when adding later results.
